usage: The word '牙' (ngaa4) is a noun used to refer to a tooth or teeth in animals or humans.
It can be used to talk about the number, condition, or appearance of teeth.
You can use '牙' alone or with a measure word when counting or specifying teeth.
It often appears in expressions related to dental care, eating, or biting.
In compound words, '牙' can describe specific types of teeth or related body parts.
